_note: SYNTHETIC. The request as it would arrive: a returning family, a destination, a window, a budget band, and a few sentences in their words.

dates.why: School holidays. Both parents have a hard stop on the 18th.

in_their_words: Five days, Tokyo and Kyoto. The kids want the robot and video-game side of Japan, we want food and a temple or two. Please do not make us get up at dawn every day. One theme park at most.
